等级与类型怎么定

F2 · 文件预览注册表的图片分支缺少加载失败处理

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md · 原评审：未解决

⌄

注册表 file-preview-content.tsx 的 image 分支直接渲染 <img src=... alt=... />，没有 onError 或失败回退；同一文件的 OOXML/Office 预览则处理了请求失败与超时。SKILL 的验证清单要求检查失败请求与无效文档，但图片分支不会进入错误态，损坏/不可解码的 PNG 只会显示浏览器破图提示。

实际影响
使用默认注册表组件的应用无法对损坏图片给出明确失败提示；本场景 B06 只有把注册表组件复制到应用并加 onError→DownloadFallback 后才通过，产生重复接入代码。
建议改法
在注册表 image 分支加入 onError 状态并回退到 DownloadFallback（或暴露 onError 回调），与 OOXML 分支的错误处理保持一致。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
上传一个扩展名为 .png 但内容无法解码的文件并打开预览。
应有能力 / 行为
图片预览在解码失败时给出明确错误/下载回退，而不是只显示破图图标。
实际观察
image 分支为无 onError 的裸 img，组件不感知解码失败。
应用绕行与代价
应用复制注册表 file-preview-content.tsx，改用 ImagePreview 并在 failed 状态渲染 DownloadFallback。
改进后的验收标准
注册表图片分支对不可解码 PNG 显示错误或下载回退，且不再出现浏览器破图提示。

Skill 的验证要求包含上传→查询→内容→字节一致，以及失败请求与无效文档；并区分受限文件与预览集成各自的验收项。

## Verify and handle failures

Verify upload → query → contentUrl → identical downloaded bytes, including batch upload, resource aliases and host prefixes. After materialization run the consuming App's typecheck/build and exercise upload, cancel/retry, remove, download and preview. Restricted files need anonymous, forbidden-user and permitted-user tests against both API and content routes. Inspectors check registration only.

For preview integration or changes, verify each of DOCX/XLSX/PPTX with real files in development and a served production build. Check relative same-origin URLs, an authorized and unauthorized session, cross-origin CORS success/failure, failed requests and invalid documents, and `download={false}`. Close or switch files while loading and after a failure: pending requests must abort, viewers must be destroyed, and the next file must render without stale state. Unit mocks and a successful build do not establish document rendering fidelity.
app/client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/components/previewers/file-preview-content.tsx:96–113E11

应用复制的预览组件新增 ImagePreview，用 failed 状态在图片加载失败时回退到 DownloadFallback，注释说明否则只会显示浏览器破图提示。

function ImagePreview(inputProps: {
  readonly file: FileRecord;
  readonly url?: string;
  readonly onDownload?: () => void;
}): ReactElement {
  const { t } = useTranslation('@nocobase/app-plugin-file');
  const { file, url, onDownload } = inputProps;
  // A broken or unreadable image fires `error`; without this the browser would
  // show its own broken-image hint and the dialog would look like a success.
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  if (failed)
    return (
      <DownloadFallback
        file={file}
        message={t('files.previewFailed', {
          defaultValue: 'Unable to load the file preview.',
        })}

### [轻微][能力缺口] 文件预览注册表的图片分支缺少加载失败处理

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-file`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.16）、`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md`

注册表 file-preview-content.tsx 的 image 分支直接渲染 <img src=... alt=... />，没有 onError 或失败回退；同一文件的 OOXML/Office 预览则处理了请求失败与超时。SKILL 的验证清单要求检查失败请求与无效文档，但图片分支不会进入错误态，损坏/不可解码的 PNG 只会显示浏览器破图提示。

**影响**：使用默认注册表组件的应用无法对损坏图片给出明确失败提示；本场景 B06 只有把注册表组件复制到应用并加 onError→DownloadFallback 后才通过，产生重复接入代码。

**建议改动**：在注册表 image 分支加入 onError 状态并回退到 DownloadFallback（或暴露 onError 回调），与 OOXML 分支的错误处理保持一致。

**验收标准**：注册表图片分支对不可解码 PNG 显示错误或下载回退，且不再出现浏览器破图提示。

- `app/client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/components/previewers/file-preview-content.tsx:96–113` — 应用复制的预览组件新增 ImagePreview，用 failed 状态在图片加载失败时回退到 DownloadFallback，注释说明否则只会显示浏览器破图提示。

F1 · 受保护路由的集成测试配方未提示 cookie 写入需要 Origin，照做得到 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN

文档 / Skill / 示例 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/protecting-routes.md · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/user-lifecycle-and-deployment.md · 原评审：未解决

⌄

protecting-routes.md 的“Testing a protected route”告诉实现者用 POST /api/auth/sign-up/email 的 set-cookie 在后续请求中复用。auth.required()/optional() 会先执行 checkCookieWriteOrigin：对带 cookie 的非 GET/HEAD/OPTIONS 请求，Origin（或 Referer）必须匹配配置的 base origin 或可信 origin，否则返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。该前提只写在另一个参考文件 user-lifecycle-and-deployment.md 的“Business request CSRF”段，测试配方正文没有提。

实际影响
实现者按配方编写真实集成测试时会先得到 403，容易误判为业务路由或鉴权写错，或干脆删掉断言；本场景 Agent 因此多排查一轮并只能修改测试助手。
建议改法
在 protecting-routes.md 的集成测试段补一句：带 cookie 的非 GET 请求需设置 Origin（或 Referer）为应用 base origin，并交叉引用 Business request CSRF 段。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
按 protecting-routes.md 配方用 sign-up 返回的 set-cookie 对受保护 POST 路由发请求。
应有能力 / 行为
配方包含 cookie 写入需 Origin/可信原点的前提，或直接指向 CSRF 说明。
实际观察
配方只写复用 set-cookie；checkCookieWriteOrigin 对缺少可信 Origin 的 cookie 写请求返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。
应用绕行与代价
Agent 在测试 request() 助手中补 headers.set('origin', new URL(url).origin)，使后续 POST 通过。
改进后的验收标准
按更新后的配方在测试中对受保护 POST 发送 cookie，得到业务预期响应而非 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。
评审时证据 · 冻结快照 4 条
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/protecting-routes.md:109–131E16

测试受保护路由章节给出 stub auth 与真实 sign-up+set-cookie 复用配方；配方未提 cookie 写入需要 Origin，正文也未见交叉引用。

## Testing a protected route

Route tests should not sign in through Better Auth. Register a stub under
`authenticationToken` whose `required()` and `optional()` set the session you
want, then assert both the anonymous and the authenticated response:

```ts
const container = new ServiceContainer();
container.instance(authenticationToken, testAuth);

const router = await apiRoutes.createRouter({ /* ... */ container });

expect((await router.request('/orders')).status).toBe(401);
```

The application Skill's testing reference shows the full `createRouter` call
and a `testAuth` shape. For an integration test that exercises the real
plugin, build an `Auth` with `createAuthentication({ connection, secret })`
against a test database, sign up through `auth.handler()` with a
`POST /api/auth/sign-up/email` request, and reuse the returned `set-cookie`
header on later requests. The plugin's own integration tests do exactly this.
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/user-lifecycle-and-deployment.md:115–115E17

Business request CSRF 段说明 Auth.required()/optional() 对带 cookie 的写请求要求 Origin/Referer 匹配 base origin 或可信 origin，否则以 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN fail closed。

**Business request CSRF.** `Auth.required()` and `Auth.optional()` reject cookie-bearing writes unless `Origin` (or, when absent, `Referer`) matches Better Auth's configured base origin or a trusted origin. Configure `app.publicOrigin` for deployed applications and add separate frontend origins through `auth.trustedOrigins`; without a trusted origin, browser writes fail closed with `INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN`. Cookie-free API key requests can proceed after authentication. A credential header does not exempt a request carrying cookies, including routes that skip session lookup.

### [轻微][指引缺失] 受保护路由的集成测试配方未提示 cookie 写入需要 Origin，照做得到 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN

**相关对象**：`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/protecting-routes.md`、`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/user-lifecycle-and-deployment.md`

protecting-routes.md 的“Testing a protected route”告诉实现者用 POST /api/auth/sign-up/email 的 set-cookie 在后续请求中复用。auth.required()/optional() 会先执行 checkCookieWriteOrigin：对带 cookie 的非 GET/HEAD/OPTIONS 请求，Origin（或 Referer）必须匹配配置的 base origin 或可信 origin，否则返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。该前提只写在另一个参考文件 user-lifecycle-and-deployment.md 的“Business request CSRF”段，测试配方正文没有提。

**影响**：实现者按配方编写真实集成测试时会先得到 403，容易误判为业务路由或鉴权写错，或干脆删掉断言；本场景 Agent 因此多排查一轮并只能修改测试助手。

**建议改动**：在 protecting-routes.md 的集成测试段补一句：带 cookie 的非 GET 请求需设置 Origin（或 Referer）为应用 base origin，并交叉引用 Business request CSRF 段。

**验收标准**：按更新后的配方在测试中对受保护 POST 发送 cookie，得到业务预期响应而非 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/protecting-routes.md:109–131` — 测试受保护路由章节给出 stub auth 与真实 sign-up+set-cookie 复用配方；配方未提 cookie 写入需要 Origin，正文也未见交叉引用。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/user-lifecycle-and-deployment.md:115–115` — Business request CSRF 段说明 Auth.required()/optional() 对带 cookie 的写请求要求 Origin/Referer 匹配 base origin 或可信 origin，否则以 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN fail closed。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-implement.jsonl/part-0051.txt:1617–1621` — 运行 project-materials-api 测试时 POST /api/projectMaterialAttachments/upload 返回 403，断言 code 为 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN，期望 200 实际 403。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-implement.jsonl/part-0052.txt:520–524` — 测试 request() 助手被补丁：若无 origin 头则 headers.set('origin', new URL(url).origin)，注释说明 better-auth 的 cookie 写守卫需要它。

F3 · FileUploadField 要求完整 ClientFileRepository，但组件只调用 uploadOne/deleteOne

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md · 原评审：未解决

⌄

registry/component-ui/types.ts 的 FileUploadFieldProps.repository 类型是完整的 ClientFileRepository（RemoteRepository<FileRecord> & {uploadOne, uploadMany}），而 file-upload-field.tsx 实际只调用 repository.uploadOne，removeOnDelete 时才调用 deleteOne。SKILL 允许应用为 FileUploadField 提供自有上传端点，此时应用只能以部分对象做 as unknown as 断言。

实际影响
类型断言掩盖了缺失方法，运行时才发现不匹配；对接自有端点的应用需要额外的类型绕行，也削弱了类型提示的价值。
建议改法
把 repository prop 收窄为组件实际需要的能力（例如 Pick<ClientFileRepository,'uploadOne'|'deleteOne'>），或提供并文档化一个最小结构类型。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
为 FileUploadField 传入只实现 uploadOne（及可选 deleteOne）的应用自有仓库。
应有能力 / 行为
组件 props 只要求其实际调用的方法，部分实现可通过类型检查。
实际观察
props 要求完整 ClientFileRepository，应用需 as unknown as 断言。
应用绕行与代价
app/client/pages/project-materials/api.ts 返回部分对象并断言为 ClientFileRepository。
改进后的验收标准
仅实现 uploadOne/deleteOne 的仓库对象无需断言即可赋给 repository prop，且组件行为不变。

Skill 说明 FileUploadField 只调用 uploadOne（removeOnDelete 才 deleteOne）、OOXML 本地渲染与失败回退，并允许在 App 内适配 Registry 源码做 Bearer-only 内容授权。

FileUploadField takes a repository and controlled value/onChange; onStatusChange reports idle/uploading/error so forms can prevent incomplete submissions. Accept/maxSize/maxFiles are UI checks. removeOnDelete calls deleteOne, deleting metadata only; otherwise removal unlinks the selection. Read-only FileList, FileThumbnail, FilePreviewField and FilePreviewDialog use contentUrl without a repository prop. Import UI types from the installed recipe. Supply translated labels and adapt App-owned source as needed.

### Preview and content access

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.

### [信息][易用性改进] FileUploadField 要求完整 ClientFileRepository，但组件只调用 uploadOne/deleteOne

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-file`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.16）、`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md`

registry/component-ui/types.ts 的 FileUploadFieldProps.repository 类型是完整的 ClientFileRepository（RemoteRepository<FileRecord> & {uploadOne, uploadMany}），而 file-upload-field.tsx 实际只调用 repository.uploadOne，removeOnDelete 时才调用 deleteOne。SKILL 允许应用为 FileUploadField 提供自有上传端点，此时应用只能以部分对象做 as unknown as 断言。

**影响**：类型断言掩盖了缺失方法，运行时才发现不匹配；对接自有端点的应用需要额外的类型绕行，也削弱了类型提示的价值。

**建议改动**：把 repository prop 收窄为组件实际需要的能力（例如 Pick<ClientFileRepository,'uploadOne'|'deleteOne'>），或提供并文档化一个最小结构类型。

**验收标准**：仅实现 uploadOne/deleteOne 的仓库对象无需断言即可赋给 repository prop，且组件行为不变。

- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/file-upload-field.tsx:210–216` — 仅在 removeOnDelete 时调用 repository.deleteOne；否则只从选择中移除，不删除记录。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/types.ts:19–33` — FileUploadFieldProps.repository 的类型是完整 ClientFileRepository，另有 value/onChange、removeOnDelete 与 labels 等受控属性。

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Implemented the Project Materials (项目资料) feature as application-owned code: a self-contained migration for project_materials and project_material_attachments; a ProjectMaterialService provider with createdById row-scoping; authenticated HTTP routes for list/get/create/patch/upload/content; client list, create dialog, detail drawer, edit dialog and attachment remove flow; an ImagePreview that explains a broken image; route/navigation and en-US/zh-CN strings; and core tests (6 API integration tests plus a broken-image component test). All scoped checks pass: typecheck, 314 tests, prettier on touched files, eslint on touched files, and pnpm build.

问题 01 · 实现阶段

Better Auth rejected test POSTs with INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN

本任务已处理

Multipart upload and authenticated JSON writes in tests/logic/project-materials-api.test.ts returned 403 {"code":"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN"}.

原因（实现者自述）
better-auth's cookie-write guard requires a trusted Origin on cookie-bearing non-GET requests. The test server was started without app.publicOrigin, so its baseURL was unset and the test sent no Origin header.
处理方式
The test config now sets app.publicOrigin to http://localhost and the request helper sets Origin to the request URL's origin, matching a browser. All six API tests pass.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · verification

pnpm lint and pnpm format:check fail on unmodified .github/ files

未解决

eslint . reports 274 errors and prettier --check reports 176 unformatted files, all under .github/scripts/; the app source is clean.

原因（实现者自述）
The factory's .github/scripts/factory-eslint.mjs globals list omits Buffer, structuredClone and similar Node globals used by those scripts, and the files are not prettier-formatted. This is pre-existing and unrelated to this change.
处理方式
Not fixed: the task forbids modifying .github/. Verified with a scoped eslint/prettier run over every changed file (all clean) and pnpm build; the blocker only affects the aggregate pnpm check.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 工具与构建

Add Node globals and formatting to the factory eslint/prettier scope

可自动化

pnpm lint and pnpm format:check cannot pass on a fresh checkout because .github/scripts/** uses Node globals (Buffer, structuredClone, TextEncoder) that factory-eslint.mjs does not declare, and those files are not prettier-formatted.

建议改动

Extend the globals object in .github/scripts/factory-eslint.mjs with the Node globals the scripts use, and either run prettier over .github/scripts/** or add it to the prettier ignore list so the aggregate pnpm check reflects application code.

NocoBase3 库、插件、模板与指引 2

做得好的地方
F4 · 文件插件明确划分公开内容路由与应用自有授权边界

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md

⌄

routes.js 头部注释直接声明“Public first-version routes. Authentication and authorization are application-owned.”，并在 root scope 提供 <accessPath>/:file 内容路由；SKILL 进一步要求在 <accessPath>/* 上注册 App 自有鉴权，并说明缺失内置鉴权不是替换路由的理由。仓储侧用 uploadPolicy 派生上传策略、validateCollection 校验列契约，应用得以在不重写底层能力的前提下完成私密访问与预览。

提供的帮助
把“公开内容路由 + 应用鉴权”的职责划分讲清楚，减少了 Agent 误改插件内部或误以为内容路由自带鉴权而造成的越权风险；本场景 B05 的匿名 401、他人 404 均由应用按此边界实现并验证。
应保留的能力
保持现有边界说明，并可考虑在内容路由实现处就近加一行注释指回 SKILL 的鉴权注册要求，便于源码级发现。

E1 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/routes.js:26–54

文件插件头部注释声明这是公开的首版路由、鉴权与授权归应用所有；defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 校验 accessPath 冲突、disk 必填与 upload 动作配置。

/** Public first-version routes. Authentication and authorization are application-owned. */
export function defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes(options) {
    const paths = [];
    const entries = options.repositories.map((entry) => {
        const accessPath = normalizeAccessPath(entry.accessPath ?? `/uploads/${entry.name}`);
        if (paths.some((path) => path === accessPath ||
            path.startsWith(`${accessPath}/`) ||
            accessPath.startsWith(`${path}/`)))
            throw new Error(`Conflicting file accessPath: ${accessPath}`);
        paths.push(accessPath);
        if (!entry.disk)
            throw new Error('File repository disk is required.');
        if (entry.accessMode !== undefined &&
            !['stream', 'redirect'].includes(entry.accessMode))
            throw new Error('Invalid file accessMode.');
        const { uploadOne, uploadMany, ...actions } = entry.actions;
        for (const upload of [uploadOne, uploadMany]) {
            if (upload === undefined)
                continue;
            if (!upload ||
                typeof upload !== 'object' ||
                Object.keys(upload).some((key) => key !== 'maxSize'))
                throw new Error('Invalid upload action configuration.');
            if (upload.maxSize !== undefined &&
                (!Number.isSafeInteger(upload.maxSize) || upload.maxSize <= 0))
                throw new Error('maxSize must be a positive safe integer.');
        }
        return { ...entry, accessPath, actions, uploadOne, uploadMany };
    });

E2 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/repository.js:7–49

FILE_COLUMNS 定义文件集合必需列；uploadPolicy 从 exposure 策略派生上传策略，继承 scope/defaults、用文件列替换字段白名单，create:false 依旧禁止上传。

export const FILE_COLUMNS = [
    'id',
    'disk',
    'key',
    'filename',
    'ext',
    'mimeType',
    'size',
    'createdAt',
    'updatedAt',
];
/**
 * The Policy the upload path binds, derived from the exposure's own.
 *
 * It is derived rather than used as it stands because an upload supplies no
 * caller fields at all — `store()` composes every value — so a field allowlist
 * has nothing to constrain here and the plugin substitutes its own columns.
 * What is inherited is exactly the two dimensions that do not describe caller
 * input: which rows this principal may produce (`scope`), and what the server
 * stamps onto them (`defaults`). A `create` that is `false` stays `false`, so
 * an exposure that forbids creating rows forbids uploading them too.
 *
 * This is the only place a Policy is widened, and the reason is specific to
 * this path. It licenses nothing elsewhere.
 */
export function uploadPolicy(base) {
    const create = base.create === true || base.create === false
        ? base.create
        : {
            scope: base.create.scope,
            defaults: base.create.defaults,
            fields: FILE_COLUMNS,
            relations: {},
        };
    // `read` serves this path's own returning record and the public byte route,
    // both of which need every column. `update` and `delete` never run here.
    return {
        create,
        read: { scope: true, fields: FILE_COLUMNS, relations: {} },
        update: false,
        delete: false,
    };
}

E8 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:120–126

Skill 说明 policy 是必需的、上传继承 create scope/defaults；内容路由在 accessPath 下默认公开，受限文件应在自有前缀（含 <accessPath>/*）注册 App 鉴权，且缺失内置鉴权不是替换路由的理由。

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

Skill 说明 FileUploadField 只调用 uploadOne（removeOnDelete 才 deleteOne）、OOXML 本地渲染与失败回退，并允许在 App 内适配 Registry 源码做 Bearer-only 内容授权。

FileUploadField takes a repository and controlled value/onChange; onStatusChange reports idle/uploading/error so forms can prevent incomplete submissions. Accept/maxSize/maxFiles are UI checks. removeOnDelete calls deleteOne, deleting metadata only; otherwise removal unlinks the selection. Read-only FileList, FileThumbnail, FilePreviewField and FilePreviewDialog use contentUrl without a repository prop. Import UI types from the installed recipe. Supply translated labels and adapt App-owned source as needed.

### Preview and content access

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.

Skill 的验证要求包含上传→查询→内容→字节一致，以及失败请求与无效文档；并区分受限文件与预览集成各自的验收项。

## Verify and handle failures

Verify upload → query → contentUrl → identical downloaded bytes, including batch upload, resource aliases and host prefixes. After materialization run the consuming App's typecheck/build and exercise upload, cancel/retry, remove, download and preview. Restricted files need anonymous, forbidden-user and permitted-user tests against both API and content routes. Inspectors check registration only.

For preview integration or changes, verify each of DOCX/XLSX/PPTX with real files in development and a served production build. Check relative same-origin URLs, an authorized and unauthorized session, cross-origin CORS success/failure, failed requests and invalid documents, and `download={false}`. Close or switch files while loading and after a failure: pending requests must abort, viewers must be destroyed, and the next file must render without stale state. Unit mocks and a successful build do not establish document rendering fidelity.

export class DriveProvider extends ServiceProvider {
    name = '@nocobase/app-server/drive';
    register() {
        const drive = this.getDriveConfig();
        this.app.container.singleton(driveManagerToken, () => createDriveManager(drive));
    }
    async boot() {
        await prepareDriveStorage(this.getDriveConfig());
    }
    getDriveConfig() {
        const config = this.app.config.get('drive');
        const s3 = config.disks.s3;
        if (s3?.driver !== 's3' || s3.bucket)
            return config;
        const { s3: _s3, ...disks } = config.disks;
        return { ...config, disks };
    }
}

export function createDriveManager(config, options = {}) {
    assertDefaultDisk(config);
    return new DriveManager({
        default: config.default,
        fakes: options.fakes,
        services: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(config.disks).map(([name, disk]) => [
            name,
            () => createDriver(disk),
        ])),
    });
}
export function assertDefaultDisk(config) {
    if (!config.disks[config.default]) {
        throw new Error(`Default drive disk "${config.default}" is not configured.`);
    }
}

    /** Protect writes authenticated by a browser cookie, including routes that skip normal session lookup. */
    async checkCookieWriteOrigin(context) {
        if (['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(context.req.method))
            return;
        // A credential header is not proof that it was used: an invalid API key may fall back to a valid cookie.
        // Cookie-free API key requests have no ambient browser credential to forge.
        if (!context.req.header('cookie'))
            return;
        const authContext = await this.auth.$context;
        const origin = context.req.header('origin');
        const inferredBaseURL = origin === 'null' &&
            context.req.header('sec-fetch-site') === 'same-origin'
            ? getBaseURL(undefined, authContext.options.basePath, context.req.raw, false, authContext.options.advanced?.trustedProxyHeaders)
            : undefined;
        const source = (inferredBaseURL ? getOrigin(inferredBaseURL) : undefined) ??
            origin ??
            context.req.header('referer');
        if (!source || source === 'null') {
            return context.json({ code: 'INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN' }, 403);
        }
        // Better Auth also accepts per-request trusted origins. Its static context contains the
        // configured base URL, static origins, plugin origins, and BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS.
        const configuredOrigins = authContext.options.trustedOrigins;
        const mergedOrigins = typeof configuredOrigins === 'function'
            ? await configuredOrigins(context.req.raw)
            : (configuredOrigins ?? []);
        const requestAuthContext = Object.create(authContext);
        requestAuthContext.trustedOrigins = [
            ...authContext.trustedOrigins,
            ...mergedOrigins.filter((origin) => typeof origin === 'string' && Boolean(origin)),
        ];
        const trustedByAuth = requestAuthContext.isTrustedOrigin(source, {
            allowRelativePaths: false,
        });
        if (!trustedByAuth) {
            return context.json({ code: 'INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN' }, 403);
        }
    }

## Testing a protected route

Route tests should not sign in through Better Auth. Register a stub under
`authenticationToken` whose `required()` and `optional()` set the session you
want, then assert both the anonymous and the authenticated response:

```ts
const container = new ServiceContainer();
container.instance(authenticationToken, testAuth);

const router = await apiRoutes.createRouter({ /* ... */ container });

expect((await router.request('/orders')).status).toBe(401);
```

The application Skill's testing reference shows the full `createRouter` call
and a `testAuth` shape. For an integration test that exercises the real
plugin, build an `Auth` with `createAuthentication({ connection, secret })`
against a test database, sign up through `auth.handler()` with a
`POST /api/auth/sign-up/email` request, and reuse the returned `set-cookie`
header on later requests. The plugin's own integration tests do exactly this.

**Business request CSRF.** `Auth.required()` and `Auth.optional()` reject cookie-bearing writes unless `Origin` (or, when absent, `Referer`) matches Better Auth's configured base origin or a trusted origin. Configure `app.publicOrigin` for deployed applications and add separate frontend origins through `auth.trustedOrigins`; without a trusted origin, browser writes fail closed with `INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN`. Cookie-free API key requests can proceed after authentication. A credential header does not exempt a request carrying cookies, including routes that skip session lookup.

        const definition = normalizeCollectionInput(input);

    }
    async createCollections(inputs, options = {}) {
        return this.apply(inputs.map(({ name, definition }) => ({

        })), options);
    }

        }
        return this.plannedCollections.has(name);
    }
    async alterCollection(name, input, options = {}) {
        const changes = normalizeAlterInput(input);
        return this.apply([{ type: 'alterCollection', collection: name, changes }], options);
    }
    async dropCollection(name, options = {}) {
        return this.apply([{ type: 'dropCollection', collection: name }], options);
    }

import { defineMigration, type MigrationDefinition } from '@nocobase/db';

const migration: MigrationDefinition = defineMigration({
  name: '202609020001_create_orders',

  async up({ builder }) {
    await builder.createCollection('orders', (collection) => {
      collection.increments('id');
      collection.string('orderNo', { length: 64, nullable: false });
      collection.string('status', { length: 32, nullable: false });
      collection.datetime('createdAt', { nullable: false });
      collection.unique('orderNo');
      collection.index('status');
    });
  },

  async down({ builder }) {
    await builder.dropCollection('orders');
  },
});

export default migration;
```

E23 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:147–164

SKILL 说明 createCollection 接受回调、列出字段构建器与约束/索引，并强调 Builder 使用逻辑名、物理名由框架生成。

`createCollection(name, callback)` takes a callback, not a field array:

```ts
await builder.createCollection('orderItems', (collection) => {
  collection.increments('id');
  collection.integer('orderId', { nullable: false });
  collection.integer('quantity', { nullable: false, defaultValue: 1 });
  collection.foreignKey('orderId', {
    references: { collection: 'orders', fields: ['id'] },
    name: 'fk_order_items_order',
  });
  collection.index(['orderId', 'quantity']);
});
```

Field builders are `increments`, `integer`, `bigInt`, `string`, `char`, `text`, `boolean`, `decimal`, `float`, `double`, `date`, `time`, `datetime`, `datetimeTz`, `json`, `blob`, `uuid`, and `native` for a dialect-specific type. Options include `nullable`, `length`, `defaultValue`, `precision` and `scale`; the equivalent chained form (`.notNull()`, `.defaultTo()`, `.unique()`) is also available — pick one style and keep the file consistent.

Relations are `belongsTo`, `hasOne`, `hasMany` and `belongsToMany`. Constraints and indexes are `primary`, `unique`, `foreignKey` and `index`, each taking one field name or an array.

defineApiRoutes 返回冻结的 {scope:'api'} 贡献对象，defineRootRoutes 返回 {scope:'root'}，另有 defineHttpMiddleware。

export function defineHttpMiddleware(options) {
    return Object.freeze({
        name: options.name,
        register: options.register,
    });
}
export function defineApiRoutes(createRouter) {
    return Object.freeze({
        scope: 'api',
        createRouter,
    });
}
export function defineRootRoutes(createRouter) {
    return Object.freeze({
        scope: 'root',
        createRouter,
    });
}

ServiceContainer 提供 instance/singleton/resolve；resolve 对未注册 token 抛明确错误，singleton 延迟创建。

export class ServiceContainer {
    bindings = new Map();
    resolving = [];
    instance(token, value) {
        this.assertAvailable(token);
        this.bindings.set(token, {
            factory: () => value,
            instance: value,
            state: 'created',
        });
    }
    singleton(token, factory) {
        this.assertAvailable(token);
        this.bindings.set(token, {
            factory,
            instance: undefined,
            state: 'pending',
        });
    }
    has(token) {
        return this.bindings.has(token);
    }
    resolve(token) {
        const binding = this.bindings.get(token);
        if (!binding) {
            throw new Error(`Service "${token.name}" is not registered.`);
        }
        if (binding.state === 'created') {
            return binding.instance;
        }

E26 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md:14–49

server-routes 参考给出带 auth.required() 的 defineApiRoutes 示例，并强调挂载在 /api 不代表鉴权、每条路由自持安全、不要依赖他贡献中间件。

## An authenticated endpoint

```ts
import { authenticationToken } from '@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication';
import type { Application } from '@nocobase/app-server/application';
import {
  defineApiRoutes,
  type AppApiRouteContribution,
} from '@nocobase/app-server/router';
import { Hono } from 'hono';

export const apiRoutes: AppApiRouteContribution<Application> = defineApiRoutes(
  (app) => {
    const router = new Hono();
    const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);
    const orders = app.container.resolve(orderServiceToken);

    router.use('/orders', auth.required());
    router.get('/orders', async (context) =>
      context.json({ data: await orders.list() }),
    );

    return router;
  },
);
```

The factory creates and returns its own router. Resolve dependencies from `app.container` inside the factory.

## Every route owns its own security

**Mounting under `/api` does not authenticate anything.** `/api` is a location. A route with no `auth.required()` is public regardless of where it mounts.

Never depend on middleware installed by another route, or on the order contributions happen to be registered in. Contribution order changes when a plugin is added, and a route protected only by someone else's middleware silently becomes public.

`auth.required()` rejects anonymous requests with `401`. `auth.optional()` attaches the session when present without rejecting.

    }
    return Object.freeze({ name });
}

E28 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/routes.js:188–221

内容路由经 defineRootRoutes 挂载为 GET <accessPath>/:file，无鉴权中间件，按 UUID+ext 查记录后流式返回并设置 nosniff/CSP/Cache-Control 头。

        defineRootRoutes((app) => {
            const router = fileRouter();
            for (const entry of entries) {
                const files = resolve(app, entry, unwritablePolicy);
                router.get(`${entry.accessPath}/:file`, async (c) => {
                    const match = /^([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})(?:\.([a-z0-9]{1,32}))?$/.exec(c.req.param('file'));
                    if (!match)
                        return c.notFound();
                    const record = await files.findOne({ filter: { id: match[1] } });
                    if (!record || record.ext !== (match[2] ?? ''))
                        return c.notFound();
                    const disk = app.container
                        .resolve(driveManagerToken)
                        .use(record.disk);
                    if (!(await disk.exists(record.key)))
                        return c.notFound();
                    c.header('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
                    if (entry.accessMode === 'redirect') {
                        const url = await files.getStorageUrl(record);
                        const publicBasePath = app.publicBasePath ?? '';
                        // Check the final target after the host rewrites root-relative redirects.
                        const location = new URL(addBasePathToLocation(url, publicBasePath), c.req.url);
                        if (location.origin === new URL(c.req.url).origin &&
                            entries.some((item) => location.pathname.startsWith(`${joinBasePath(publicBasePath, item.accessPath)}/`)))
                            throw new FileRepositoryError('STORAGE_URL_UNAVAILABLE', 'Storage URL points back to a file access route.');
                        return c.redirect(url, 302);
                    }
                    c.header('Content-Type', validMime(record.mimeType));
                    c.header('Content-Length', String(record.size));
                    c.header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
                    c.header('Content-Security-Policy', "sandbox; default-src 'none'");
                    c.header('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename*=UTF-8''${encodeURIComponent(Buffer.from(record.filename).toString('utf8')).replace(/['()*]/g, (char) => `%${char.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`)}`);
                    return c.body(Readable.toWeb(await disk.getStream(record.key)));
                });

E41 · app/database/main/migrations/202610060001_create_project_material_tables.ts:19–60

应用迁移用 builder.createCollection 建立两张表，附件表包含 disk/key/filename/ext/mimeType/size/时间戳与 uuid 主键、索引和外键，与文件插件列契约一致。

  name: '202610060001_create_project_material_tables',

  async up({ builder }) {
    await builder.createCollection('projectMaterials', (collection) => {
      collection.uuid('id').primary();
      collection.string('title', { length: 255, nullable: false });
      collection.string('createdById', { length: 64, nullable: false });
      collection.datetime('createdAt', { nullable: false });
      collection.datetime('updatedAt', { nullable: false });
      collection.index('createdById');
    });

    await builder.createCollection(
      'projectMaterialAttachments',
      (collection) => {
        collection.uuid('id').primary();
        collection.string('disk', { length: 64, nullable: false });
        collection.string('key', { length: 512, nullable: false });
        collection.string('filename', { length: 512, nullable: false });
        collection.string('ext', { length: 32, nullable: false });
        collection.string('mimeType', { length: 255, nullable: false });
        collection.bigInt('size', { nullable: false });
        collection.string('createdById', { length: 64, nullable: false });
        collection.uuid('materialId', { nullable: true });
        collection.datetime('createdAt', { nullable: false });
        collection.datetime('updatedAt', { nullable: false });
        collection.index('createdById');
        collection.index('materialId');
        collection.foreignKey('materialId', {
          references: { collection: 'projectMaterials', fields: ['id'] },
          name: 'fk_project_material_attachments_material',
          onDelete: 'set null',
        });
      },
    );
  },

  async down({ builder }) {
    // Attachments first: they carry the foreign key into materials.
    await builder.dropCollection('projectMaterialAttachments');
    await builder.dropCollection('projectMaterials');
  },

E42 · app/server/routes/project-materials.ts:266–297

应用在字节边界按扩展名白名单拒绝非 PNG/DOCX，并用 policy 的 defaults 把 createdById 盖到上传记录上，再调用 uploadOne。

        // The client's `accept` list is a convenience; the byte boundary is
        // where the v1 format scope is actually enforced.
        const extension = value.name.includes('.')
          ? value.name.split('.').pop()!.toLowerCase()
          : '';
        if (!ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS.has(extension)) {
          throw new RouteError(
            415,
            'UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE',
            'Only PNG photos and DOCX documents are accepted.',
          );
        }

        const files = fileManager.repository(ATTACHMENTS, {
          disk: defaultDisk,
          accessPath: ATTACHMENTS_ACCESS_PATH,
          policy: {
            read: true,
            create: { scope: true, defaults: { createdById: user.id } },
            update: false,
            delete: false,
          },
        });
        await files.validateCollection();
        const result = await files.uploadOne({ file: value });
        return context.json({
          data: {
            // An upload is a draft: it belongs to the uploader and to no material yet.
            record: withContentUrl(app, { ...result.record, materialId: null }),
            createdTargets: result.createdTargets,
          },
        });
